text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day right before the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a contender in the Tenno Sho (Spring), 
Sounds of Earth was being interviewed 
about her pre-race enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ――Titled: "Spring is a Storm."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
In this year's Tenno Sho (Spring), the 
melodies of these captivating Umamusume 
will intertwine to create a truly 
magnificent symphony.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You can count on me. ...And look forward 
to my victory as well.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Ooooh...!)

Den-den-de-den♪ Den-de-deen♪ 
De-de-den-den♪ Den-de-deen♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Daaaaaang!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...*Repeat the following.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
G-Gold Ship...! One of the top favorites 
for this year's Tenno Sho (Spring)...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Is that a declaration of war...?! What on 
earth is going--

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh. How's that? Making muuusic isn't your 
exclusive specialty, you know.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Molto bene!! That was such a wonderfully 
upbeat and cheerful piece of music!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh, you actually understand 
Golshi-chan's musicality? Not bad at 
all...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Alright then. How 'bout we stir things up 
a bit... as a little greeting?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ho— I accept your challenge!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Vroom-vroom cha-la-ka poon-spoon-spoon♪ 
Doom-doom vroooom fufufufu-foooorn♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Vroom vroom tick tick swoosh honk♪ 
Chaka-lapa chaka-lapa don-tsuku-dun♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What in the world are we watching...!? 
I have no idea what's going on... and 
yet...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
My body is moving to the rhythm... all on 
its own...!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Ta-daaaaah♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...I acknowledge you, Sounds of Earth.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Bring on that muuuusiiic of yours, piping 
hot like a kettle fresh off the stove!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —I'm honored, Golshi-san.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the melody dwelling within you... 
might just be too grand for this 
world...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And after that, it's the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: That's right—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the blue sky, the crisp sound of 
their high five echoed pleasantly—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And then, the day of the Tenno Sho 
(Spring) arrived.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see this video of Golshi and 
Earth? These two are seriously way too 
intense!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You sure know how to hype things up in the 
weirdest ways. I don't hate it, though...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
She's not just strong, she's hilarious, 
which is why I just gotta root for Gold 
Ship!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
I get it, I get it. You just can't help 
wanting to chase after them, right?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Golshi-san really is incredible, isn't 
she?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That power to liven up a session just by 
being there... It's something no one else 
could ever replicate...!
choice_data_list:
And she's a formidable opponent, without a 
doubt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While Gold Ship is undeniably an 
outrageous entertainer, there's no 
question that she is also a runner of 
overwhelming talent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She will likely be one of the fiercest 
opponents Sounds of Earth has ever faced—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why an unprecedented 
performance is born. ...Don't you agree?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What kind of music will a direct clash 
with one so close to the center of the era 
create? I find myself thrilled from the 
bottom of my heart...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Let us enjoy it together. This storm of 
spring!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heheh—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's a sin, really... Golshi-chan gets the 
whole floor hyped up just by existing, 
like a flash sale...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Can you really do it, Earth? Can you... 
stick on that 10% off sticker?!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufuâ Shall we let sound speak more 
eloquently than words?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I'll let you hear a melody that exceeds 
all your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sounds fun! It's practically a steal with 
that half-price sticker!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—Even when facing Golshi-san, you're 
acting just like your usual self.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...So that's what makes you strong, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Shion-san!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Let's make today another marvelous 
session. Shall we create the ultimate 
harmony together!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...I'm just gonna run like I always do.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the spotlight... all I can do 
is run my own race.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, let it resound to the fullest...! 
That melody which belongs to you alone!"
